entities.summary: The Royal Moroccan Football Federation is the governing body for association football in Morocco. The federation administers the national football league system and oversees its top division, the Botola Pro. It is also responsible for the Morocco national football teams across all age categories and disciplines. Moroccan Football Federation is a nonprofit organization in Rabat, established in 1956. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
